title: A bounded methods tranche separates useful representation changes from proxy gains and prompt-pilot scores

scientific_scope_status: The completed first methods report distinguishes same-output evidence reduction, a different useful operation and an improved proxy that damages the next task. Its selected allocation model exposes a tradeoff between counting gates and completing capability lines at equal action credits. Its prompt pilot has12responses on THREE retrospective cases, six per condition: a small descriptive scaffold-score edge without executed next actions, held-out cases, strict compute parity or causal discovery evidence.
